Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was operating a sedan in the left lane of a multi-lane roadway in League City, Texas, when the vehicle made
a lane change into the adjacent lane. Driver 2, traveling in that lane, was unable to avoid contact, and the two
vehicles sideswiped one another along the passenger side of Driver 1's car and the driver side of Driver 2's car.
Dirver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy under which the vehicle is registered. A Passenger was seated in
the front right seat and was present at the scene. Officers and the statements gathered at the scene confirm that the
Passenger was inside the vehicle at the time of impact. Driver 1 reported back strain following the collision and stated
pain began sohrtly afterward, though it is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash. Photographs taken at
the scene confirm several details of the sequence, and the damage to both vehicles is consistent with the described
impact. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle is known to the reporting officer. No independent witnesses were
identified, so the account relies on the statements of the drivers and the physical evidence recorded at the scene.
</page>
